release_notice: New: Maps routes, voice selection and whole-house announcements with Sonos grouping, resume and volume.
title: Configure speech voice
language_default: Use the default voice for this language
translation_help: Pick a preferred voice for each language you announce in. Languages without a preference use a matching Cloud voice. If this option is off, announcements use basic Google TTS.
no_voices: No Cloud voices are available. Check the Cloud Text-to-Speech configuration in the app settings.
choose_language: Choose an announcement language to preview.
speaker_all_no_tvs_help: Skip recognized TVs and video Cast receivers
speaker_all_no_tv_speakers: All speakers (no TVs or TV speakers)
speaker_all_no_tv_speakers_help: Also skip recognized soundbars and home theater speakers
speaker_help: Used by speech and translation actions. An explicit speaker on an announcement card overrides this choice. All speakers includes every discovered target; only compatible Sonos rooms can be synchronized.
